ext.connect.title: Kokangisa navigateur oyo
ext.connect.sub: Ba site etalisami na navigateur oyo etangamaka na compte na bino PR.SOCIAL. Kokangisa esengi clic moko na site.
ext.connect.wait: Pesa confirmation na page efungwami. Code ekoumela kino {time}.
ext.connect.fail: Connexion na pr.social ezali te. Botala internet na bino mpe komeka lisusu.
ext.connect.no.tasks: Navigateur ekoki kokangisama nsima ya misala {need} endimami. Silisa misala na pr.social, sima pesa confirmation ya kokangisa lisusu.
ext.connect.no.devices: Compte na bino esili kokangisama na bilembo {max}. Kokangola moko na pr.social na Bisaleli, sima pesa confirmation lisusu.
ext.connect.no.device: Navigateur oyo ekoki kokangisama te. Ba navigateur oyo programme ekambaka esungami te.
ext.connect.no.restricted: Compte na bino etyelami ndelo. Navigateur ekoki kokangisama tango ndelo ekolongolama.
ext.connect.no.off: Extension ya kotala ba site ezali na compte na bino te kino sikoyo.
ext.start.hint: Ba site ezali kofungolama na fenetre ya yango moko. Bobatela yango na skrine: bokoki kokitisa yango, kotia yango na ngobo mpe kosala na ba fenetre mosusu. Soki ekitisami mingi to ezipami mobimba na ba fenetre mosusu, ekopema.
ext.perm.why: Mpo na kotalisa ba site, extension esengi permission na Chrome mpo na kofungola site nyonso na fenetre na yango. Esalelaka permission oyo mpo na mosala mosusu te.
ext.pause.hidden.sub: Kotalisa ekoyela tango fenetre ya ba site ezongi na ekrani.
ext.pause.locked.sub: Kotalisa ekoyela yango mosika tango ordinateur efungwami.
ext.gate.blocked.sub: PR.SOCIAL akangi navigateur oyo. Kokomela Lisungi mpo na koyeba likambo mpe eloko esengeli kosala.
ext.gate.update.sub: Version oyo esalaka lisusu te. Bouton oyo ezali na nse ekofungola page ya version ya sika mpe ekolakisa ndenge ya kotia yango.
ext.gate.closed.sub: Extension ekotalelaka yango mosika, yango wana ezali na yo eloko moko te oyo esengeli kosala.
ext.off.sub: Ekangolamaki na compte na bino na pr.social. Okoki kokangisa yango lisusu na code ya sika.
ext.limits.hour.hint: Ba site boni navigateur oyo ekoki kotalisa na ngonga moko
ext.money: Mbongo ezwami ekoya na solde na bino na ntango moke. Awa ekomonana mosika.
ext.stage.title: Fenetre PR Surf
ext.stage.sub: Ba site efungolami awa kaka na yango. Bátela efenetre oyo na ekrani: okoki kokitisa yango, kotia yango na coin mpe kosala na ba fenêtre mosusu. Soki efenetre esimbami to ezipami mobimba, kotala ekopema. Okoki kotika kotala yango na extension.
ext.wait.offline.sub: Bwakisi ekokoba kaka ntango connexion ezongi. Sites esili kotalama ekobungisama te.
ext.wait.empty.sub: Sites ya sika ekoya ntango basombi basengi visites. Extension ekotala lisusu na {time} na yango moko.
ext.pause.closed.sub: Kotala ba site ezali na pause kino fenêtre esilisi kofungola lisusu. Sites esili kotalama ekobungisama te.
ext.pause.covered: Fenêtre ya sites ezali na bifenêtre mosusu likolo na yango
ext.pause.covered.sub: Sites ekotangama kaka ntango fenêtre na yango emonani. Bwakisi ekoya kosala lisusu ntango ekozonga na ekran.
ext.pause.check_missed.sub: Motuna “Bozali wana?” eyanolami te na ngonga. Bonyata Kokoba mpo na kobanda lisusu.
ext.check.sub: Bonyata bouton ya nse mpo na kokoba. Kino bokoyanola, bwakisi ezali na pause.
ext.stopped.restart: Bwakisi esili kotelema ntango Chrome esilisi kobanda lisusu. Bandisá yango lisusu ntango bokoki.
ext.net.stale: Connexion na pr.social ezali te. Nomeros ya nse ekoki kozala ya kala.
ext.why.CRASH: Page esili kozongisa te, yango wana extension efungoli onglet ya sika mpe ekobwaki kotala.
ext.why.SHORT: Page ezalaki na ekran ngonga mingi te. Tiká fenêtre ya sites efungwama mpe emonana.
ext.why.EARLY: Extension elobaki mpo na site yango liboso ya ngonga ya kotala. Talá ete date mpe ngonga na ordinateur ezala kozwama automatiquement.
ext.why.GONE: Extension elobaki mpo na site yango nsima mingi: bwakisi esili kotelema ngonga molai.
ext.why.BLOCKED: Protection ya site ekoki kotika extension kofungola page te.
ext.why.TIMEOUT: Site ezwaki ngonga molai mpo na kofunda. Ekoki kozala ezali pole to connexion ezali malamu te.
ext.update.ready: Versiyo ya sika ya PR Surf ezali. Oyo ekokoba kosala mpo na ntango moke.
